The hands match production. His left hand, with the brown-strap wristwatch on that wrist, holds the dark-blue phone from below on the screen-left side. His right thumb taps the consent tick-box from the screen-right side. The finger and thumb structure is clean, and the grip is plausible for a two-handed hold.
The phone screen shows three blank rounded fields, a teal tick-box with tap ticks and a teal submit button. There are no letters, numbers or personal data.
The plain light background at upper left leaves room for the caption. The phone's dark-blue case matches the ravi-phone description and the phone in 03-3 and 03-5.
